description: Minor Material Amendments to planning permission PA/15/00360 dated 18/12/2015, to amend the wording of condition 10 (Travel Plan) and condition 19 (School Hours). The amended conditions would read as follows:Condition 10 currently reads:Prior to the first occupation of the development a Travel Plan shall be submitted to and agreed in writing by the local planning authority.  The Travel Plan shall include details relating to public transport, car and cycle parking demand and walking to the development for employees, school children and parents.  The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved Travel Plan.Condition 10 as proposed:The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved Travel Plan ref 11045-PEF-XX-XX-TRP-H-00003 rev P03 dated 17 September 2026.Reason: To encourage sustainable transport and to ensure the amenity of nearby residents is not compromised in accordance with Policies D.DH8, D.ES9, S.TR1, D.TR2 and D.TR3 of the Tower Hamlet Local Plan (2020).Condition 19 currently reads:The teaching hours of the school hereby permitted shall start no later than 8:30 and finish no earlier than 3.55.Condition 19 as proposed:The teaching hours of the school hereby permitted shall start no later than 8.15am and finish no later than 3.00pm. For clarity, 'teaching hours' are the minimum core hours that pupils are required to be in school and do not include after school clubs and activities.Reason: To stagger the teaching hours of the new school with those of St Luke's Primary School to avoid congestion on the public highway and ensure the amenity of nearby residents is not compromised, in accordance with Policies D.DH8, D.ES9, S.TR1, D.TR2 and D.TR3 of the Tower Hamlet Local Plan (2020).
